review: Static inspection of frozen source, corroborated by all actual archived payloads; no original policy or summary helper executed by the independent reconstruction

receives: fixed workload schema and serving response schema
fixed system prompt and semantic prose
four best valid plus four latest same-cell trials, deduplicated
measured execution and feedback attached to selected history
does_not_receive: construction seed or selected witness IDs
direct filesystem, shell or simulator tool handles

actors.interpretation: Defined target-agnostic sampling control, not an information-matched mechanism ablation

actors.target_use: Target residual/loss computed outside the cache from the same stored activity profile
actors.budget: Cache hits, identical initializations and rejected proposals still occupy requested slots

actors.selection: First three qualifying witnesses in generation order, slots 1, 2, 6; no policy performance used

reference_visibility.interpretation: Compact history is not the entire information channel; valid earlier references can appear through derived notebook content. This is not evidence of cross-cell leakage.

transport.unresolved_marker_behavior: Refuses resampling; existing completed response reused
transport.serialization: Meter lock and nonoverlapping recorded intervals, allowing 50 ms timestamp tolerance
transport.limits: No HTTP packet trace or provider-internal attempt ledger; no assertion that an API failure was billed or free

startup_checks: Docker image ID resolved from tag
runtime.per_replay_image: Historical evaluator invokes agcws:window-validation-v1 by tag; individual result records do not attest a resolved image digest
runtime.interpretation: No drift identified. This audit does not prove the tag never changed during execution; future comparisons need pinned runtime and evaluator-equivalence checks.

classification.literal_leakage: No checked witness metadata, witness-program history match, search/witness cache overlap or cross-cell history discrepancy found
classification.information_asymmetry: Pro actively consumes semantics and feedback while phase-random does not; consistent with the frozen control, insufficient to isolate why Pro wins
classification.distribution_alignment: Both operate within phase/release/weight grammar; constructor-family alignment remains untested out of family
classification.scope: Scoped eight-bin activity matching, not gate power, productive application computation or proof of deep RTL understanding
